(129,338 / 34,519 / 37,042 / 221), Rsource Holdings, LLC (168,890 / -1,258), Brandt Information Services, LLC (114,047 / 39,968 / 23,961); Total Investment Portfolio fair value $1,514,360 thousand.

Same note: 'See below for more information on the ULTRA III unfunded commitments:' table lists Brandt (26,000 / -21), Compsych (43,333 / 433), FH BMX (14,840 / 66 and 49,978 / 221), Rsource (50,000 / -1,258), Sentinel (19,200 / -188), Total $203,351 / $(747). These are the source of the remaining bare-axis facts including Brandt Information Services, LLC (-21) and FH BMX Buyer, Inc. 5 (66) that the prior revision of this rule RETAINED.

'The Company's investment in ULTRA III is disclosed on the Company's Consolidated Schedules of Investments as of December 31, 2025 and 2024.' The fund's own exposure to ULTRA III is its retained LLC-interest position line in the main SOI; the JV note schedule describes the investee vehicle's portfolio, consistent with the 2026-07-21 adjudication in data_investigation_results.md part 5.

The printed 2025-12-31 main consolidated SOI contains SLF V AD1 Holdings, LLC - LLC Interest (fair value 9,298), CCI Topco, Inc. - Preferred Stock (2,184) and AMR GP Holdings Ltd - Ordinary Shares (1,568) as fund positions whose XBRL contexts were tagged with bare InvestmentIdentifierAxis members (no affiliation suffix). The main SOI contains NO Brandt, FH BMX, Emerus, Rsource, Compsych or EHOB rows.

bdc_holdings 2025-12-31 current-period rows: 823 affiliation-suffixed rows sum 25,324,370,000 and 25 bare-axis rows sum 1,527,921,000 (848 rows, 26,852,291,000 total). Keeping all suffixed rows plus the three printed main-SOI bare positions (13,050,000) yields 25,337,420,000, equal to fund_financials investments_at_fair_value to the dollar. The 22 excluded bare rows sum 1,514,871,000 = printed ULTRA III portfolio 1,514,360,000 plus its separately tagged unfunded-commitment facts (net 511,000).

rationale: The 2025-12-31 filing tagged the fund's own schedule with '| Non-Affiliated Issuer' affiliation members but left two groups of contexts bare: (a) the ULTRA III, LLC joint-venture note schedule and its unfunded-commitment table (look-through disclosure of the unconsolidated investee's portfolio, not fund holdings), and (b) three genuine main-SOI positions (SLF V AD1 Holdings LLC Interest, CCI Topco Preferred Stock, AMR GP Ordinary Shares). This revision partitions the bare rows by printed-schedule membership: exclude every bare row except the three printed main-SOI positions. The prior revision selected its retained set by fitting the residual to the anchor at a time when six suffixed rows were missing upstream; against the printed schedules it retained six ULTRA III note facts (Brandt 2, Brandt bare, FH BMX 2/4/5/6, net 74,974,000) and wrongly excluded the fund's real SLF V AD1 Holdings, LLC position (9,298,000). Membership in the printed schedules, not subset-sum reconciliation, is the mechanism.
